name: Mario Party™: The Top 100
description:
For years, the Mario Party series brought us together around our home consoles... ever since the original launched on Nintendo 64. We partied like it was 1999... because it was. And now, the best minigames from all 10 home console titles are going portable.

We’ve curated the top 100 minigames – the most ever in a single Mario Party title – to create the best one yet. The game supports Download Play for up to 4 people, so with just one Game Card, any of your friends with a Nintendo 3DS family system can join in too!

Visit amiibo.nintendo.eu for compatible amiibo™ and the latest information. To use amiibo on Nintendo 3DS, Nintendo 3DS XL and Nintendo 2DS systems a Nintendo 3DS NFC Reader/Writer is required.
disclaimer:
Additional systems required for multiplayer mode. Sold separately.

Due to the size of this game, it may take longer to download the digital version of this title when compared to other Nintendo eShop games. At the time of purchase you can choose either “Download Now” to begin to download the game immediately or
“Download Later” to download the game when the system enters “Sleep Mode.”

You may need to upgrade your current SD Card to a compatible SDHC Card or microSDHC Card with enough available space to download this software.
Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.

amiibo™ compatible game (software update may be required). Wii U and New Nintendo 3DS™ XL systems have built-in amiibo support; other systems in the Nintendo 3DS family require a peripheral device (available 2015; sold separately). Compatibility and functionality of amiibo figures may vary per game. Visit http://www.nintendo.com/amiibo/compatibility/ for specific details on how each amiibo works. amiibo sold separately.
